n: Digital Schoolhouse Just Dance with the Algorithm
t: A two part workshop that teaches algorithms through dance and then Scratch.
steps: Find Just Dance with the Algorithm on the Digital Schoolhouse site.
Check that the page is free and read the terms.
Watch a recording of a live follow-along session.
Clear a space for Part 1 and gather flowchart materials.
Teach Part 1 first with no technology.
Ask IT to confirm that devices can run Scratch for Part 2.
Teach Part 2 and move the routines into Scratch.
